tool_input.command: sed -i '' 's/if (weightKg < maxWeightKg)/if (weightKg <= maxWeightKg)/' src/Storefront/Shipping/ShippingCalculator.cs && git diff --stat && dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ShippingCalculatorTests" 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Fix bracket comparison and run shipping tests

result:
- **Cause:** A real regression from the express shipping commit (`a67da70`), not a flaky test or a runner-02 problem. The refactor into a bracket table changed the weight check from `<=` to `<`, so a parcel of exactly 5 kg fell into the 20 kg bracket (14.90 instead of 7.90). Exactly 1 kg and 20 kg were wrong in the same way. `xping report` shows the same error on 3 machines and CI.
- **Action:** In `src/Storefront/Shipping/ShippingCalculator.cs`, `RateFor` now uses `weightKg <= maxWeightKg` again. The test is unchanged. All 9 `ShippingCalculatorTests` pass locally; I did not run the full suite.

The fix is not committed or pushed, so the pipeline will only go green once you push it.

`xping report` also lists `Checkout_NumbersInvoicesUniquely_WhenCheckoutsRunInParallel` as failed in the latest run. It is marked known flaky in cloud and I did not touch it, but it could still turn the pipeline red.
